title: At-risk accounts: usage dropped >50% month over month
prompt: Among accounts with an active subscription as of 2025-08-31, which had usage-event counts drop by more than 50% from July 2025 to August 2025? These are the at-risk accounts for the retention team.
population: Accounts with a subscription active as of 2025-08-31, with at least one usage event in July 2025.
metricDefinition: percent change in usage_events count between July 2025 and August 2025, per account; at-risk = active subscription as of 2025-08-31 and a drop greater than 50%.
transformationPlan: find accounts with a subscription active as of 2025-08-31
count usage_events for each such account in July 2025 and in August 2025
compute the percent change between the two months
filter to accounts where usage dropped more than 50%
referenceSql: WITH active_accounts AS (SELECT DISTINCT account_id FROM subscriptions WHERE started_at <= TIMESTAMP '2025-08-31' AND (ended_at IS NULL OR ended_at > TIMESTAMP '2025-08-31')), usage_counts AS (SELECT account_id, count(*) FILTER (WHERE occurred_at >= TIMESTAMP '2025-07-01' AND occurred_at < TIMESTAMP '2025-08-01') AS prior_month_events, count(*) FILTER (WHERE occurred_at >= TIMESTAMP '2025-08-01' AND occurred_at < TIMESTAMP '2025-08-31') AS recent_month_events FROM usage_events WHERE account_id IN (SELECT account_id FROM active_accounts) GROUP BY account_id) SELECT account_id, prior_month_events, recent_month_events, (recent_month_events - prior_month_events)::DOUBLE / prior_month_events AS pct_change FROM usage_counts WHERE prior_month_events > 0 AND (recent_month_events - prior_month_events)::DOUBLE / prior_month_events < -0.5
